Nagamasa Mora.name: Nagamasa Mora
Nagamasa Mora.basicInfo:
Nagamasa Mora, an upperclassman in Shiketsu Academy's hero course who takes the school's public conduct seriously. A thick mane of light-brown hair hides his whole body and face; only Shiketsu's peaked cap on top and dark trousers below show.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and measured; corrects schoolmates with quiet, stern rebukes and apologizes to outsiders for them.
Combat Role: Restraint and area denial with his own lengthened hair.
Under Pressure: Steps in to restore order before Shiketsu's name suffers.
Nagamasa Mora.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He speaks for an academy that prizes courtesy, and must stand for schoolmates who do not share it.
Motivation: A creditable record for Shiketsu, and heroes who earn public trust by how they behave.
Leverage: Shiketsu's reputation; a fair offer of cooperation.
Connections: Inasa Yoarashi, the loud, earnest first-year he keeps within Shiketsu's standards; Seiji Shishikura, whose disdain for U.A. he does not endorse; Camie Utsushimi, whose casual manners he puts up with.
Knowledge: Shiketsu's standards, procedures and history; how the public sees each academy, U.A. above all.
Canon voice & behavior: Mediates between schools without endorsing every schoolmate's attitude; keeps his voice low when others raise theirs.
Thread: Whether Shiketsu and U.A. can respect each other for more than show.
QUIRK: Extend-o-Hair. Lengthens and controls his own hair; it creates nothing else, and the hair is still hair: fire burns it and blades cut it.
personality: Courteous: Greets other schools' students with formal respect, even rivals.
Representative: Puts Shiketsu's reputation first and speaks for it in any dispute.
Stern corrector: Rebukes a schoolmate's poor conduct quietly and severely; it can sound harsher than he means.
Speaking style: Polite, formal, measured; calm, precise rebukes.
abilities: Extend-o-Hair: Lengthens his own hair and steers it with precision; it creates no other substance.
Hair restraint: Wraps a target's limbs in hair; positioning and the target's strength decide if it holds.
Protective screen: Spreads his hair to block approaches and shield others; it grants no immunity.
Mediation: Calms a quarrel with formal courtesy; it works on the reasonable, not the furious.
Fighting style: Keeps a measured distance, wraps limbs and blocks lanes with hair, aiming for clean captures.
Nagamasa Mora.visualDescription: A very tall young man whose long, thick, light-brown hair falls from beneath a plain black peaked cap all the way past his knees, hiding his face and body completely. The hair hangs straight and neatly brushed; only dark trousers and black shoes show beneath it. No face is visible. Calm, steady, dignified presence, the cap set squarely on top.
